project_info.theme: Vintage-optics fashion portrait against a luminous gradient
project_info.color_palette: inky black, charcoal gray, muted amber, soft sage, warm skin tones

main_subject.detail: An adult East Asian woman with long softly waved black hair, natural luminous skin, subtle warm makeup, and an elegant feminine silhouette. She wears a fitted black sleeveless dress and turns her head over one shoulder toward the camera with a quiet, self-possessed expression.

items: long dark hair falls over the back and shoulder with a few loose face-framing strands
fitted black sleeveless dress creates a clean uninterrupted silhouette
infinite gradient-lit background transitions from charcoal gray to muted warm amber and sage
the figure is set slightly right of center with generous negative space

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large diffused key at approximately 4300K with a restrained warm rim light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: crisp facial planes, subtle warm highlights on hair and shoulders, soft background glow, realistic shadows enhancing the dress silhouette
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: elegant, poised, cinematic, and quietly alluring

technical_specs.render_style: 28mm lens, Contax Zeiss-inspired vintage optics, crisp film sharpness, natural vignetting
technical_specs.color_treatment: rich controlled contrast, subtle warm highlights, gentle grain, natural skin texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical three-quarter fashion-editorial portrait of an adult East Asian woman with long softly waved black hair, natural luminous skin, subtle warm makeup, and an elegant feminine silhouette. She wears a fitted black sleeveless dress and turns her head over one shoulder toward the camera with a quiet, self-possessed expression. Keep a few loose face-framing strands and let her dark hair fall along her back and shoulder. Place her against an infinite gradient-lit background transitioning from charcoal gray to muted warm amber and soft sage, with generous negative space. Use a large diffused key at approximately 4300K plus a restrained warm rim light to create crisp facial planes, subtle warm highlights on hair and shoulders, a soft background glow, and realistic shadows enhancing the dress silhouette. Shoot on a 28mm lens with Contax Zeiss-inspired vintage optics: crisp film sharpness, rich controlled contrast, gentle grain, natural vignetting, and natural skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, explicit body measurements, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The source moodboard is optional and should preserve the over-shoulder pose, long black hair, fitted black sleeveless dress, gradient backdrop, and vintage-optics lighting. An approved-adult face reference may be attached when identity consistency is needed; preserve that person's face, facial structure, and likeness. The background colors and wardrobe can be replaced while maintaining an elegant fitted-dress silhouette and cinematic vintage direction.
